description:
Position Overview

Ready to break free from clinic burn-out and build something that is truly yours?

At Finni Health, we were built with a single mission: to empower passionate BCBAs to launch, own, and lead their own thriving practices. For far too long, dedicated providers have been overworked, undervalued, and boxed in by traditional clinic models. It’s time for a change—and you can be the one to lead it.

We are hunting for visionary practice owners ready to partner with us in expanding access to world-class autism care. By pairing our cutting-edge software suite with your clinical expertise, our all-in-one launchpad gives you complete freedom to deliver the ethical, life-changing care every family deserves.

Whether your dream is to transform your local community or to provide services for underserved families within state lines, we will stand by your side to build your therapy practice from the ground up.

Take the driver's seat of your career, rekindle your passion for ABA, and help us lay the foundation to empower BCBAs nationwide. Your practice starts here. Let's build it together.

Learn more here: https://www.finnihealth.com/providers


What the role entails!

  • Launch with Built-In Infrastructure: Collaborate with our team using our pre-built guidelines, handbooks, and clinical operations frameworks to get your practice up and running seamlessly.

  • Hassle-Free Billing & Payor Management: Partner directly with our insurance experts to handle billing, clear payor requirements, and meet submission deadlines—so you actually get paid on time without the administrative headaches.

  • Lead & Mentor Your Clinical Team: Provide impactful field and virtual supervision for Behavior Technicians, delivering real-time feedback and training to ensure top-tier ABA intervention delivery.

  • Deliver Meticulous, Evidence-Based Care: Conduct functional assessments, craft progress reports, and continuously adapt treatment plans grounded in the latest research findings.

  • Empower Families & Caregivers: Collaborate directly with families to design customized behavior support strategies and deliver hands-on intervention training to parents and staff alike.

    Qualifications

  • Master's Degree in Applied Behavioral Analysis, Special Ed, Psychology, or Related Field

  • Valid BCBA Certification.

  • Applicable licensure to practice within the state hired.

  • Minimum three years experience in ABA, with supervisory roles preferred.

  • Strong leadership skills.

  • Strong oral and written communication skills.

Why partner with Finni?

Starting a practice used to be risky, overwhelming, and lonely. We fixed that. Finni handles the heavy lifting so you can focus on what you love—delivering exceptional care and owning your future.

  • Be a Trailblazer: Transform the ABA landscape by bringing high-quality, personalized care to families who need it most.

  • Ethics Over Output: You protect your workload. No bloated caseloads, no burnout culture—just world-class care delivered by supported providers.

  • Unmatched Mentorship & Resources: Gain full access to top-tier training curricula, clinical tools, and continuous mentorship to elevate your team’s expertise.

  • Ongoing Support: Turn your dream of practice ownership into reality with a team built entirely around your success.


Compensation Package:

  • Imagine a career where your paycheck has no ceiling and your drive directly dictates your success. With unlimited earning potential, your effort isn't just rewarded—it's multiplied. Break past fixed salaries, take complete ownership of your income, and build the financial freedom you’ve always wanted. How far you go is entirely up to you.


Schedule:

  • Flexible


License/Certification:

  • BCBA (Required)
